name: Raeya
source:
Dedicated and brave, Praefectus Raeya takes her role as Limbo's protector extremely seriously, but the truth behind the realm's darkest times will soon put her loyalty —and her ability to keep you out of harm's way— to the test.

[From [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
